# Lurk API

> Lurk is a real-time listings API for European second-hand marketplaces: Vinted, Wallapop, Milanuncios and Todocolección. It pushes every new listing over a WebSocket, as JSON, the moment it is published. Developers use it to build deal bots, resale monitors, Telegram or Discord alerts and price trackers without running scrapers, proxies or anti-bot workarounds.

Lurk (lurk.insomnis.dev) is an independent service. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Vinted, Wallapop, Milanuncios or Todocolección, none of which offer a public API for reading new listings from other sellers.

## How it works

- Endpoint: `wss://api.lurk.insomnis.dev/v1/feed`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` header, or `?key=` when the client cannot set headers.
- `?platforms=vinted,wallapop,milanuncios,todocoleccion` picks the platforms (default: every platform in the subscription).
- `?format=raw` (default) sends each listing exactly as its platform provides it; `?format=normalized` sends the main fields with the same shape on every platform (id, title, description, price_in_cent, currency, brand, url, url_photo, shipping, location, attributes such as size and condition, category, user_id, completeness).
- One JSON event per new listing: `{format, platform, source, items}`. Push-based streaming, not polling.
- Every new listing is delivered, with no event limits or quotas. Filtering by keyword, brand, size or price happens in your own code.
- Not a search or history API: it is a stream of new listings. Store them yourself if you need history.
- Free public demo, no key: `wss://api.lurk.insomnis.dev/v1/demo` sends real listings in real time, one per second per platform.
- Example clients in Python, Node.js and Rust in the docs.

## Pricing (per month, before VAT, no commitment)

- Vinted: €49
- Wallapop: €39
- Milanuncios: €19
- Todocolección: €19
- Pay only for the platforms you pick; add or remove them any time with the same key. 3 simultaneous connections per key. Reselling the events to your own users (for example a paid alert bot) is allowed.

## Español

Lurk es una API en tiempo real que manda por WebSocket cada anuncio nuevo de Vinted, Wallapop, Milanuncios y Todocolección en cuanto se publica. Sirve para crear bots de chollos, monitores de reventa y alertas sin scrapers ni proxies. Desde 19 €/mes por plataforma, con demo gratuita sin key.
